reason: In July and August I can't answer the same Wi-Fi and pool questions at midnight from abroad, and €120 for the season is nothing next to one week's booking at the villa. If it catches the routine stuff and sends the real problems to my WhatsApp, it's worth trying, especially with the refund.
objection: Booking and Airbnb already send automatic messages for free, and my guests pay a lot, so they expect a person, not a chatbot. If it gives one wrong answer about the pool or check-in, that's a bad review on an expensive villa.
would_change_my_mind: If setup required me to be in Omiš or Split in person at a time I'm abroad, or if my son tried it and found it no better than the free Booking auto-messages, I would drop it.
